items.summary: Binary-choice truth benchmarks ask models to choose between a correct and an incorrect answer, but if the two answers differ systematically in surface-level features, models can exceed chance without performing the intended reasoning. items.title: MedRoundsQA: A Persona and Difficulty Aware Evaluation for Multi-Turn Medical Consultations
items.summary: Medical benchmarks are dominated by single-turn, multiple-choice clinical cases that poorly reflect real consultations. Practically, clinicians elicit evidence interactively and patient communication varies widely. items.title: K-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM Unlearning in Agentic Deployments
